title: Million Dollar Dream Comes True: in Victoria
heading: Dreams do come true!
description: Have you ever had a dream about winning money. A lucky Australian won $1 million by playing lottery numbers she dreamt about.
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
Australian Lotto Millionaire dreams her winning numbers

An Australian woman has recently won an Australian 6/45 jackpot after playing numbers that came to her in a dream. The Victoria resident held one of the three division one winning entries in the April 12, 2023 draw, securing a total prize of $1,006,109.05.

Upon confirming her win with a lottery official, the woman shared her excitement, saying, “I almost fainted! This is very exciting! We all dream of winning the lottery and were very surprised! I checked my online account and saw I’d won a million dollars, I thought, ‘No! No way!’ I’m so overwhelmed. It’s a very nice surprise! Oh my god!”

The woman revealed that she always plays these numbers as they were in a dream of hers. She remembered the numbers and put them all on a Lotto ticket.

“We’re still deciding how best to use the prize, but it will make things a whole lot easier,” the woman said, when asked about her plans for the money.

Winning the lottery is always an exciting event, but this woman’s story adds an extra level of intrigue. It’s not every day someone wins the lottery by playing numbers from their dream. It may seem like a one-in-a-million chance, this woman’s story is proof that anything is possible.
